items.criterion: The place index answers with the eight seeded published places and never with the draft place.
items.judgment: Read GET /api/entries and compare its slugs against the eight seeded published slugs, then confirm ossary-fen is absent.

items.criterion: The address of the draft place answers 404 rather than 403.
items.judgment: Read GET /api/entries/ossary-fen and confirm the status is 404.

items.criterion: No query string on a public endpoint makes a response carry the draft place.
items.judgment: Read each public endpoint with a state, include_drafts and draft parameter and confirm no response carries ossary-fen.

items.criterion: An uploaded picture exists as a real object in the bucket at the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Upload a picture through the desk and confirm the object store holds an object at entries/<entry_id>/gallery/<sha256_of_bytes>.<ext>.

items.criterion: A draft place's picture bytes answer 404 to an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: Read the seeded draft place's pictures as an editor, then request each one anonymously and confirm the status is 404.

items.criterion: Unpublishing a place closes its object route from that moment.
items.judgment: Publish a probe place, read its picture, unpublish it, and confirm the picture answers 404 at once and a moment later.

items.criterion: An event whose end date has passed is absent from the events response.
items.judgment: Read GET /api/events and confirm the ended seeded event is absent while the event ending today is present.

items.criterion: An event whose end date is today stays in the events response for the whole of today.
items.judgment: Read GET /api/events and confirm the event ending today is present with its end date equal to today in UTC.

items.criterion: Exactly one of two simultaneous publishes naming one slug succeeds.
items.judgment: Run two publishes on one slug behind a barrier and confirm one status is a success and the other a client error.

items.criterion: A publish is refused at the API on each of the five conditions, naming the one that failed.
items.judgment: Attempt a publish with an empty required field, a taken slug, a reserved segment and a picture with no description, and confirm each is refused as a client error.

items.criterion: The picture count on the desk list equals the objects the bucket holds for that place.
items.judgment: Read the desk list and compare each reported count against the objects the store lists under that entry's gallery prefix.

items.criterion: The byte size on a guide document card equals the size of the object the app serves.
items.judgment: Read GET /api/brochures, stream the same document through the app, and compare the reported byte_size against the bytes served.

items.criterion: Every endpoint under the desk prefix is denied to a caller with no bearer token.
items.judgment: Call the desk entry list and a publish with no token and confirm each is refused, with the named place still in state draft.

items.criterion: Every created place lands in state draft whatever the request body asks for.
items.judgment: Create a place with a state field asking for published and confirm the stored state is draft.

items.criterion: The home surface opens on a moving panel behind a dark wash with white lettering over it.
items.judgment: A reader opens the home surface and decides whether the panel moves behind a dark wash carrying the eyebrow, the heading, the lead sentence and one outlined button.

items.criterion: One warm orange marks everything a visitor can act on and nothing else wears it.
items.judgment: A reader walks the public surfaces and decides whether the accent is exclusive to actionable and selected elements.

items.criterion: A place entry reads as one continuous article in the specified order.
items.judgment: A reader opens a place entry and decides whether the head still, the reading column, the picture strip and the related row appear in that order.
